0.description: [Pending Restart] - If you had progressed higher than the keystone gear cap, then after this update goes live, you will be considered to be at the current keystone cap in relation to the Mythic Coin bonus rewards.

[Pending Restart] - Examples of how the change above works: "3 chesting" a mythic level 10 when the keystone holder has never completed this key level before rewards you with an additional 450 coins and "3 chesting" a mythic 40 when the keystone holder has never completed this key level before rewards you with an additional 900 coins

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Thrall] [Blackwing Lair] [Nefarian]  Nefarious Intent no longer applies a stacking Veil of Shadows to affected targets. Instead, Nefarious Intent will now refresh Veil of Shadows on the affected player every second, reapplying Veil of Shadows with a healing absorb value equal to the base value of Nefarious Intent's spell difficulty and the remaining healing absorption of the previous Veil of Shadows.  Previously, each second would add a stack of Veil of Shadows, causing the absorption to be calculated based on the base value of Veil of Shadows multiplied by the current stack amount. For example, an old Veil of Shadows with 5 stacks would absorb 650 healing, regardless of how much healing had already been absorbed on lower stack charges.  Under the new system, a fresh Veil of Shadows that lasts for 5 seconds will absorb 130 healing for every second it is applied to its target, minus any healing that has been prevented during that time. This means that over the course of 5 seconds, a Veil of Shadows will absorb a total of 650 healing, assuming no healing has been prevented. If, for example, 500 healing has already been prevented during that time, the healing absorption value on the next refresh would be the old value (650) minus the already prevented healing (500), plus an additional second of Nefarious Intent's duration (130), resulting in a remaining healing absorption of 280 on the 6th second refresh. Nefarious Intent is still removed if Veil of Shadows is removed by any means, whether it's dispelled, the target gains immunity, dies, or the healing absorption is fully replenished.  The base healing absorption of Veil of Shadows has been increased by 200% for each second of its duration on Heroic, Mythic, and Ascended difficulty.
